content: Proprotein convertase subtilisin/kexin type 9 (PCSK9) inhibitors, specifically monoclonal antibodies such as evolocumab and alirocumab, have demonstrated significant efficacy in reducing low-density lipoprotein (LDL) cholesterol levels. These agents are particularly beneficial for patients who exhibit intolerance to statin therapy. Clinical trials, including the ODYSSEY ALTERNATIVE study, have rigorously assessed the safety and efficacy of alirocumab in comparison to ezetimibe. The findings from this study revealed that alirocumab was superior to ezetimibe in achieving greater reductions in LDL cholesterol levels.
